claim.quote: No significant non-isotropic signal from the directional analysis was found and a 90% confidence level upper limit on spin-dependent WIMP-proton cross section of 25.7 pb for WIMP mass of 150 GeV/c2 was derived.

key_value.note: 90% CL spin-dependent WIMP-proton limit at 150 GeV/c^2.
key_value.quote: of 25.7 pb for WIMP mass of 150 GeV/c2

name: Direction-sensitive dark matter search with three-dimensional vector-type tracking in NEWAGE

summary.plain: Using 318 days of data with improved gamma-ray rejection and head-tail determination, NEWAGE found no direction-dependent signal and set a spin-dependent limit of 25.7 pb at 150 GeV/c^2, the best from direction-sensitive searches.
summary.technical: NEWAGE-0.3b'' (LAmu-PIC), December 2017 to March 2020, 318.0 live days = 3.18 kg d; new gamma-ray rejection (TOTsum-Length cut) and head-tail analysis; no significant non-isotropic signal; 90% CL spin-dependent WIMP-proton limit 25.7 pb at 150 GeV/c^2.

title: Direction-sensitive dark matter search with three-dimensional vector-type tracking in NEWAGE
why_it_matters: The abstract calls this the most stringent upper limit in direction-sensitive dark matter searches (as of 2023).
